This week, we're discussing what we can do with mushrooms!

A chance to post ideas and recipes relating to the ingredient.
Weekly ingredient thread: What can you do with mushrooms?

Mushrooms are so tricky, because I either really love them or really hate them. To me they have to be an accent in the dish, not the main flavor or it becomes too overpowering. Mushrooms cooked up in eggs and omelets are especially delicious, and they're always good cooked up in a stir fry.You can also put them in sauces for pasta (make sure it's veggie-based noodles though to drop calories) or use them as a meat garnish caramelized with onions.

If you're looking for unhealthy options, they're also great breaded and fried or as a pizza topping.

I buy the big portabella mushrooms, will grill those next to my hamburger and will just put the patty on that with topping on that. Makes a great mushroom burger with no bun!

Another favorite, PIZZA; Bake one side on 400 for 15 minutes, turn over, 15 minutes more, add pizza sauce [I prefer an Alfredo - less carbs] for 5 minutes, toppings [seafood is DEE-licious!] 5 more minutes, lastly bake with the cheese on it until it melts.
